def invoke_endpoint_async(self, endpoint_name: str, input_location: str) -> str:
        if endpoint_name not in self.async_results:
            self.async_results[endpoint_name] = {}
            self.async_failure_results[endpoint_name] = {}
            
        if input_location in self.async_results[endpoint_name]:
            return self.async_results[endpoint_name][input_location]
            
        output_bucket = f"sagemaker-output-{random.uuid4()}"
        output_location = "response.json"
        failure_location = "failure.json"
        from moto.s3.models import s3_backends

        s3_backend = s3_backends[self.account_id][self.partition]
        s3_backend.create_bucket(output_bucket, region_name=self.region_name)
        
        # Check if we have custom async results
        if self.async_results_queue:
            data, is_failure = self.async_results_queue.pop(0)
            
            if is_failure:
                # Store failure data
                s3_backend.put_object(output_bucket, failure_location, value=data.encode("utf-8"))
                self.async_failure_results[endpoint_name][input_location] = (
                    f"s3://{output_bucket}/{failure_location}"
                )
                
                # For failures, we still need a default output
                default_output = json.dumps({"default": "output"}).encode("utf-8")
                s3_backend.put_object(output_bucket, output_location, value=default_output)
            else:
                # Store success data
                s3_backend.put_object(output_bucket, output_location, value=data.encode("utf-8"))
                
                # For non-failures, we still need a default failure location
                default_failure = "default failure".encode("utf-8")
                s3_backend.put_object(output_bucket, failure_location, value=default_failure)
                self.async_failure_results[endpoint_name][input_location] = (
                    f"s3://{output_bucket}/{failure_location}"
                )
        elif self.results_queue:
            # Backward compatibility: use the sync results queue if no async queue
            body, _type, variant, attrs = self.results_queue.pop(0)
            json_data = {
                "Body": body,
                "ContentType": _type,
                "InvokedProductionVariant": variant,
                "CustomAttributes": attrs,
            }
            output = json.dumps(json_data).encode("utf-8")
            s3_backend.put_object(output_bucket, output_location, value=output)
            
            # Add a default failure location
            default_failure = "default failure".encode("utf-8")
            s3_backend.put_object(output_bucket, failure_location, value=default_failure)
            self.async_failure_results[endpoint_name][input_location] = (
                f"s3://{output_bucket}/{failure_location}"
            )
        else:
            # Default behavior if no queues are configured
            json_data = {
                "Body": "body",
                "ContentType": "content_type",
                "InvokedProductionVariant": "invoked_production_variant",
                "CustomAttributes": "custom_attributes",
            }
            output = json.dumps(json_data).encode("utf-8")
            s3_backend.put_object(output_bucket, output_location, value=output)
            
            # Add a default failure location
            default_failure = "default failure".encode("utf-8")
            s3_backend.put_object(output_bucket, failure_location, value=default_failure)
            self.async_failure_results[endpoint_name][input_location] = (
                f"s3://{output_bucket}/{failure_location}"
            )

        self.async_results[endpoint_name][input_location] = (
            f"s3://{output_bucket}/{output_location}"
        )
        return self.async_results[endpoint_name][input_location]
